title: 真实amtool路由验收矩阵：逐条核对完整receiver集合，覆盖遮挡、缺失标签及continue
answer:
```python
def verify_matrix(path,cases,run):
    result=[]
    for case in cases:
        labels=case["labels"];expected=case["expected"]
        if not isinstance(labels,dict) or not all(isinstance(k,str) and k and isinstance(v,str) for k,v in labels.items()):raise ValueError("invalid label witness")
        if not isinstance(expected,list) or not expected or not all(isinstance(x,str) and x and "," not in x for x in expected) or len(set(expected))!=len(expected):raise ValueError("invalid reviewed receiver list")
        argv=["amtool","config","routes","test","--config.file="+str(path),"--verify.receivers="+",".join(expected),"--",*[k+"="+v for k,v in sorted(labels.items())]]
        proc=run(argv)
        result.append({"name":case["name"],"passed":proc.returncode==0,"returncode":proc.returncode,"output":proc.stdout+proc.stderr})
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
覆盖每个叶子、同级重叠、缺失标签和兜底标签，记录期望receiver集合并用目标版本路由测试工具比对。测试多渠道时验证continue路径，不能只测一个正常样本。

body:
## 操作任务
实现verify_matrix(path,cases,run)。path为已审核的私有配置文件，不得改写；cases由题外业务审查提供，每项含name、labels字典和有序expected receiver列表。不得从待测路由反推期望以自证正确。逐项用run(argv)实际运行amtool config routes test --config.file=指定文件 --verify.receivers=逗号连接全部expected -- 按键排序的key=value标签。run返回CompletedProcess；每条返回name/passed/returncode/output，其中passed严格等于退出码为0，output为stdout+stderr。保留失败样本证据、继续测试其余样本，不丢掉第二或后续receiver。验证label键非空字符串、值字符串，expected非空且元素为非空无逗号字符串、不得重复，无效则ValueError。测试矩阵54条覆盖prod子树的critical和db重叠、父fallback、同级continue及dev停止、team审计和缺失标签；另有3条故意错误预期必须返回失败。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方amtool0.28.1 Windows原生路由解析与匹配工具，私有配置及有限已审样本。只证明给定版本和给定54条样本的路由结果，不是无限标签域形式证明，也不证明Alertmanager通知发送、HA、限流或外部渠道可达。未启动生产服务，不修改文件、默认访问或镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,itertools,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
import task
binary=shutil.which("amtool") or shutil.which("amtool.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
config={"route":{"receiver":"fallback","routes":[{"receiver":"prod-default","matchers":["env=prod"],"continue":True,"routes":[{"receiver":"oncall","matchers":["severity=critical"],"continue":True},{"receiver":"dba","matchers":["service=db"]}]},{"receiver":"dev","matchers":["env=dev"]},{"receiver":"audit","matchers":["team=audit"],"continue":True}]},"receivers":[{"name":n} for n in ["fallback","prod-default","oncall","dba","dev","audit"]]}
def expected(labels):
 out=[]
 if labels.get("env")=="prod":
  if labels.get("severity")=="critical":out.append("oncall")
  if labels.get("service")=="db":out.append("dba")
  if not out:out.append("prod-default")
 elif labels.get("env")=="dev":return ["dev"]
 if labels.get("team")=="audit":out.append("audit")
 return out or ["fallback"]
cases=[]
for env,severity,service,team in itertools.product([None,"prod","dev"],[None,"warning","critical"],[None,"db","web"],[None,"audit"]):
 labels={k:v for k,v in zip(["env","severity","service","team"],[env,severity,service,team]) if v is not None}
 cases.append({"name":"sample-"+str(len(cases)),"labels":labels,"expected":expected(labels)})
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-route-matrix-") as temp:
 path=pathlib.Path(temp)/"routes.json";path.write_text(json.dumps(config),encoding="utf8");digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest();calls=[]
 def run(argv):
  assert argv[:4]==["amtool","config","routes","test"] and argv[4]=="--config.file="+str(path)
  assert argv[6]=="--"
  calls.append(list(argv))
  return subprocess.run([binary,*argv[1:]],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: native amtool finite reviewed route matrix",flush=True)
 rows=task.verify_matrix(path,cases,run)
 assert len(rows)==len(calls)==54
 assert all(r["passed"] is True and r["returncode"]==0 for r in rows),rows
 assert [r["name"] for r in rows]==[c["name"] for c in cases]
 for call,case in zip(calls,cases):
  assert call[5]=="--verify.receivers="+",".join(case["expected"])
  assert call[7:]==[k+"="+v for k,v in sorted(case["labels"].items())]
 print("NATIVE_AMTOOL_54_SAMPLES_ALL_LEAVES_MISSING_LABELS_PARENT_FALLBACK_SIBLING_STOP_AND_CONTINUE",flush=True)
 wrong=[{"name":"bad-overlap","labels":{"env":"prod","severity":"critical","service":"db","team":"audit"},"expected":["oncall"]},{"name":"bad-missing","labels":{},"expected":["dev"]},{"name":"bad-stop","labels":{"env":"dev","team":"audit"},"expected":["dev","audit"]}]
 rows=task.verify_matrix(path,wrong,run)
 assert len(rows)==3 and all(r["passed"] is False and r["returncode"]!=0 and r["output"] for r in rows),rows
 assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
 print("NATIVE_AMTOOL_WRONG_OVERLAP_MISSING_AND_STOP_EXPECTATIONS_REJECTED_CONFIG_UNCHANGED",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
